## Choose the right route

- Reproducible Core defect: open a GitHub issue.
- Core feature proposal: open an issue before preparing a large pull request.
- Security vulnerability: use the private route in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
- Full FNLLA product, access or commercial question: visit
  [fnlla.com](https://fnlla.com).

FNLLA Core is provided under the MIT licence without a contractual support SLA.
Application code, hosting, deployment, backups and third-party integrations
remain the responsibility of the operator.
